summary: All six findings from the SPEC and STANDARDS review reports (one blocker, one major, three minor, one minor evidence-accuracy) were independently re-verified as FIXED on the current head, by reading the changed code against each finding's required_fix and by re-running the underlying gate rather than trusting the fix report's own numbers. Two review notes (SPEC-1023-02, SPEC-1016-01) remain open exactly as the fix report discloses, for reasons outside this lane's authority (a GitHub workflow_dispatch only the integrator can run; a change to another test battery's evaluator set that is out of #1016's ACs) — both are 'note' severity, correctly disclosed as not fixed rather than silently dropped, and do not block accept. No gate that passed at fix-report time failed on recheck; nothing new broke. The rig's incidental state (five throwaway databases apparently left by an earlier, usage-limit-interrupted attempt at this same recheck: clara_l10_recheck, clara_rt_test, clara_leg4_a, clara_leg4_b, plus two more I created, clara_931/932) was dropped before finishing; clara_l10 itself is unchanged from the fix report's own 'left as found' state (no World, 16 live queued document_processing_tasks, clean git status).
